verdict.rationale: incident.io documents first-party outbound webhooks that send notifications to external tools when events occur, including incidents, follow-ups and on-call data such as alerts, escalations and schedule changes. That is direct support for subscribing to events programmatically. missing for 10: documented endpoint registration and subscription mechanics, an event-type catalog, payload signing and verification, retry and delivery guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks can be used to receive notifications when certain events occur in incident.io.
syncing on-call data like alerts, escalations, and schedule changes to external tools.
Get notified the moment something changes in incident.io, so your other tools never fall out of sync.
